info.title: VDR-Suite Public API v1 — source-verified selected contract subset
info.description: PARTIAL developer reference with source-grounded F2 security transport metadata, audited against selected runtime and SecurityHttpGate source paths; a current full-release commit and complete hardware acceptance are not implied. Documents original Phase69.F resources plus Human Account lifecycle/CREATE, grant desired-state read/write, Device pairing/approval/credential issuance, Device grant administration, Device/Credential revoke and one-time credential rotation, plus Human Account Credential/Browser Session metadata and item revoke, authorized Recording keyset/folder browse, recording genre facets and EPG now/next cached reads. This is not full current API coverage, complete account/device administration coverage, or installed daemon/VIDAA runtime acceptance.
